椰子掉在路边，没人去捡。: Coconuts fall by the roadside, and nobody picks them up.
海南的太阳毒，你永远晒不白。: The sun in Hainan is fierce, and you’ll never get any paler.
你在海边吃了一顿海鲜，比内地便宜一半。: You ate a seafood meal by the sea, half the price of inland.
赶场天，镇上的人比过年还多。: On market day, the town had more people than at New Year.
雨季来了，雨一下就是半个月。: The rainy season came, and once it started, it rained for half a month.

山路弯弯绕绕，坐车坐得人发晕。: The mountain road twisted and turned, and the car ride made people dizzy.

下午的茶馆里，老人们在打麻将，一打就是一下午。: In the teahouse in the afternoon, the old folks were playing mahjong, one game lasting all afternoon.

山城的路上上下下，导航也会迷路。: The roads in the mountain city go up and down, and even the navigation gets lost.
雾很大的时候，对面的楼都看不见。: When the fog was thick, you couldn’t see the building across the street.
你吃了一碗酸辣粉，辣得嘴唇发麻。: You ate a bowl of hot-and-sour noodles, and your lips went numb from the spice.
你学会了吃折耳根，一开始觉得怪，后来离不开了。: You learned to eat zheergen (fish mint root). At first it seemed strange, then you couldn’t do without it.
你家楼下的米线店，一碗米线配三样小菜。: The rice noodle shop below your building: a bowl of noodles with three small side dishes.
你骑车去了一趟湖边，风吹得很舒服。: You cycled to the lake, and the wind felt lovely.
雨季的菌子上市了，家家都在炒菌子，大人说一定要炒熟。: In the rainy season, wild mushrooms came to market, every family was frying them, and the grown-ups said they must be cooked through.
一碗酸汤鱼，酸得你直眯眼睛，又忍不住多喝一碗。: A bowl of sour soup fish, so sour you squinted, and you still couldn’t help having another bowl.
酥油茶喝惯了，到了外地反倒想得慌。: Once you’re used to butter tea, you miss it terribly when you’re away.
转经的老人从你身边走过，嘴里念念有词。: An old pilgrim walked past you, muttering prayers.
太阳很近，天很蓝，脸上晒出了两块红。: The sun is close, the sky very blue, and your face got two red patches.
风沙大的时候，嘴里全是沙子。: When the wind and sand blew hard, your mouth was full of sand.
晚上的夜市，烤肉的香味飘了几条街。: At the night market in the evening, the smell of grilled meat drifted for several streets.

你家的窗台上，总晾着一排风干的辣子。: On your windowsill there is always a row of wind-dried chili peppers.
天很高，云很低，好像伸手就能摸到。: The sky is high and the clouds low, as if you could reach out and touch them.
过年的时候，家里炸了一大锅油饼。: At New Year, the family deep-fried a big pot of flatbread.
早上一碗牛肉面，一清二白三红四绿。: A morning bowl of beef noodles: clear broth, white radish, red chili oil, green cilantro.
你学会了唱一首花儿，调子高得你唱不上去。: You learned to sing a hua’er (folk song), pitched so high you couldn’t reach it.
你吃了一碗羊肉泡馍，馍掰得越碎越好吃。: You ate a bowl of yangrou paomo (lamb and bread soup), where the smaller you tear the bread, the better it tastes.
你吃了一碗凉皮，配了一个肉夹馍。: You ate a bowl of liangpi (cold skin noodles) with a roujiamo (meat sandwich).
一碗油泼面，辣子一泼，滋啦一声，香了一屋子。: A bowl of oil-splashed noodles: pour the hot oil over the chili, it sizzles, and the whole room smells wonderful.
夏天的瓜果特别甜，一个哈密瓜你一个人吃了一半。: Summer fruit is especially sweet, and you ate half a Hami melon by yourself.
秋天的胡杨林，黄得像着了火。: In autumn the poplar forest is yellow as if on fire.

地铁换乘要走十分钟，你走得比谁都快。: Changing subway lines means a ten-minute walk, and you walk faster than anyone.
城里新开了一座图书馆，周末的座位要抢。: A new library opened in the city, and on weekends you have to fight for seats.
江边的灯光秀，每到周末就有很多人去看。: The light show on the river draws a crowd every weekend.
县城的菜市场早上最热闹，卖菜的大多是附近村里的人。: The county town’s produce market is liveliest in the morning, and most of the sellers are from nearby villages.
县城的人结婚，酒席要摆三天，请帖发遍了半条街。: Weddings in the county town run three days with the banquet, and invitations go out to half the street.
村里的小卖部也能收快递了。: The village shop can handle parcels now too.
